LUPA PARA SA MGA MAGSASAKA!

Artists for Just Peace presents 'GAPAS!', a film program featuring films about peasant workers, on February 11, from 7:00 to 9:00 PM, at Chapterhouse, Quezon City. The screenings will be followed by a discussion on the farmers' struggle, leading up to the 7th anniversary of the Rice Liberalization Law (RLL) protest.

The lineup includes:
• ‘Bungkal’ by Lance Lozano
• ‘Ha’antu Ka Maku’ by Janina Magundayao
• ‘Saka Na’ by Cheska Marfori

Sign up here: https://t.co/C75WgfJwSn

𝗧𝗥𝗢𝗡 𝗜𝘀 𝗪𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗗𝗶𝗴𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹 𝗗𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗮𝗿 𝗔𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗠𝗼𝘃𝗲𝘀

There’s a difference between being talked about and being used.

@AlliumLabs, one of the most trusted on-chain data firms (used by Coinbase, Visa, Bloomberg), just put numbers to what many already feel on the ground.

Over the last 30 days, USDT didn’t just flow through TRON, it settled there.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮, 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗨𝗽

30-day USDT transfer volume:
▫️ TRON: ~$318B
▫️ Ethereum: ~$131B
▫️ BSC: ~$63B

The rest of the market shares what’s left.

Allium summed it up clearly:
TRON’s dominance reflects how USDT is actually used for cross-border payments and remittances, especially across Asia-Pacific and other emerging regions.

This isn’t speculation. It’s money moving.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗲 𝗕𝗲𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗠𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘂𝗺

▫️ $85.4B USDT now lives on TRON, over half of all USDT in existence

▫️ $7.9T in USDT transfers processed in 2025 alone

▫️ Daily USDT volume regularly hits $20–36B, often 1.5–2× Ethereum

▫️ Weekly transfer count is 6–7× higher than Ethereum

▫️ All-time USDT volume: ~$3.4T on TRON vs ~$1.6T on Ethereum

This is sustained, filtered, real usage. Not bots. Not wash activity.

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗧𝗥𝗢𝗡 𝗞𝗲𝗲𝗽𝘀 𝗪𝗶𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗥𝗮𝗰𝗲

This didn’t happen by accident.

• 𝗙𝗲𝗲𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝘀𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗲

TRC-20 USDT transfers often cost pennies. That matters when you’re sending money weekly, not once a year.

• 𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗽𝗮𝘆𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀

3-second blocks and high throughput keep transfers predictable and fast.

• 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗴𝘆 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹

Stake once, get bandwidth and energy. For many users, transfers feel effectively free.

• 𝗥𝗲𝗮𝗹-𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗮𝗱𝗼𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻

TRON is the default USDT network on major exchanges and deeply embedded in places like Vietnam, the Philippines, Nigeria, and Latin America. 
These aren’t traders chasing yield. These are people sending money home.

• 𝗗𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗯𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆𝘄𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲

More than 75% of global USDT flows now touch TRON at some point.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗔𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗠𝗲𝗮𝗻𝘀

Ethereum remains a strong settlement layer for institutions and high-value DeFi.

TRON became something else entirely.

It became the everyday settlement rail for the digital dollar.

▪️ Wages. 
▪️ Remittances. 
▪️ Merchant payments. 
▪️ P2P transfers.
▪️ Fast, cheap, and reliable, without banks taking their cut.

That’s why the gap keeps widening.

When someone asks, 
“What is TRON really for?”

You don’t need opinions. You show them the data.

TRON isn’t chasing relevance.
It’s already doing the work.

Not as a narrative.
As infrastructure.

data.text:
MARCOS CONGRATULATES JAPAN PM FOR HISTORIC WIN 🇵🇭🇯🇵

UPDATE: President Bongbong Marcos congratulated Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on her landslide victory, calling it a strong mandate from the Japanese people.

Marcos said Japan remains a close friend and trusted partner of the Philippines, noting that Tokyo’s leadership plays a vital role in the region.

The president said the Philippines looks forward to working closely with the Japanese government to further strengthen bilateral ties and advance stability in the Indo-Pacific region. @newswatchplusph
